findings.summary: 3DCoat is a commercial digital sculpting application that supports both voxel and polygonal modeling workflows. It provides tools for automatic and manual polygonal topology creation, UV mapping, and texture painting with natural media tools. The software can import models from other 3D applications via Applink plugins, convert them into voxel objects for refinement, and generate PBR texture maps. A live link to external applications allows transfer of model and texture data. The program includes an auto-retopology feature that generates a quad-dominant mesh skin over voxel sculptures.

mechanisms.title: Dynamic patch tessellation and polygonal sculpting
mechanisms.explanation: The software specializes in voxel and polygonal sculpting using dynamic patch tessellation technology, which allows for adaptive mesh refinement during sculpting operations.

mechanisms.title: Auto-retopology and quad-dominant mesh generation
mechanisms.explanation: A proprietary algorithm generates a polygonal mesh skin over voxel sculptures, composed primarily of quadrangles, enabling clean topology for further modeling or animation workflows.
